changelog: Refined the comma/adjunct upward-bias into a conditional: do not apply that upward bias when the token after the marker is an auxiliary/copula — addresses en_us_203 (prevents over-trust when a copula/predicate reinterprets a comma-terminated adjunct).

Added a negative exception for proper-name (capitalized) immediately before + lexical verb immediately after, lowering score in that surface pattern — addresses en_us_276 (prevents over-trusting bare names that are immediately reinterpreted by a following predicate).

Added a negative exception for name/organization cluster (including immediately-closed parenthetical acronym) before + reporting/lexical verb after, lowering the usual name boost — addresses en_us_738 and en_us_1000 (stops splitting names from their predicate or clarifying parentheticals).

Added a negative exception for left-end closing parenthesis (')') immediately before the marker when the token after begins a role/title common noun, lowering score — addresses en_us_1000 (prevents treating a parenthetical-terminated name as independently faithful when a descriptive predicate follows).

Made participial rule symmetric: penalize both token_before = VBN + token_after = common noun AND token_after = VBN + token_before = common noun — addresses en_us_687 (catches splits that strand the participle on either side).

Added negative exception for left-side light-pronoun + auxiliary clusters (it/they/he + have/has/had/is/was/etc.) when the token after begins with a negator/determiner ('no','a','the'), lowering score — addresses en_us_1570 (prevents over-valuing auxiliary-led fragments).
Added negative exception for finite lexical-verb before + common noun/pronoun after (likely verb→object splits), lowering score — addresses en_us_1106 (reduces over-trust at verb→object splits).

Added positive exception: raise score when the token immediately after the marker begins a contiguous capitalized multiword name cluster (two or more title-case tokens), increasing score — addresses en_us_1294 (recognizes that exposing the start of a multiword proper name often yields independent translatability).

Extended deterministic tie-avoidance in Decision Procedure to prefer not cutting immediately before auxiliaries/copulas when the left ends with a comma-terminated adjunct (tie breaks toward the non-auxiliary cut) — implements the critique 'tie_fix'.

Integrated all new narrow, surface-anchored exceptions while preserving prior numeral↔unit, repeated-unit, parenthetical/appositive, causal-connector, and participial-left signals; clarified surface-form checklist to include the new checks.
